reviews.title: Good price, solid mobo
reviews.comment: Great price and honestly it took my computer from a decade old mess to a well-functioning machine again. Took a while for the wifi to work. I recommend having a wired connection to Internet so you can update ALL your drivers and flash your BIOS before relying on the onboard wifi. I had a spare network card laying around so I used DriverEasy and then took out the wireless card. Anyway, very satisfied. Thanks micro center, very cool.
reviews.author: Uncle Chester

reviews.title: Good combo!
reviews.comment: Excellent mobo and CPU. It was relatively easy to set the wifi up, I just downloaded the drivers to a flashdrive. The 650E has PCI 5.0, which is great!
reviews.author: Jay Stewart
